intro.heading: Start Your Project with Proper Site Preparation
intro.content: Bellhouse Excavating handles full site preparation, including stripping topsoil, rough grading, land shaping, and excavation for foundations, roads, and drainage. Proper site prep sets your project up for long-term success.

fit.heading: Where This Site Prep Work Adds the Most Value
fit.subheading: Best fit for projects that need practical grading decisions, stable pads, and clear access before the next phase of construction starts.

items.title: Raw lots that need build-ready grades
items.description: A good fit when the site still needs stripping, rough grade correction, and usable elevations established before foundation, utility, or framing crews step in.
items.outcome: Gets the site into a cleaner, more buildable condition instead of leaving grading and stripping spread across multiple small scopes.

items.title: Pads, drainage shaping, and access routes
items.description: Works well when the job needs more than surface smoothing and actually depends on stable pads, sensible water movement, and dependable route prep for trucks and machines.
items.outcome: Supports a site that drains properly and stays workable for material delivery, concrete, and follow-on trades.

items.title: Contractor-led site prep with material movement
items.description: A strong fit for active projects where cut, fill, imported aggregate, and on-site material handling all need to stay aligned with schedule instead of being split between crews.
items.outcome: Helps keep prep, grading, and haul coordination moving as one operation rather than separate call-outs.

includes.heading: Site Prep & Grading Includes
includes.subheading: Everything required to turn raw land into a build-ready site.

items.title: Topsoil Stripping
items.description: Removal of organics and topsoil to expose stable subgrade.

items.title: Rough & Final Grading
items.description: We shape the land for proper drainage and building layout.

items.title: Building Pad Prep
items.description: Creation of level, compacted pads for shops, barns, and homes.

items.title: Ditching & Drainage
items.description: Ditches and swales to manage water and protect structures.

equipment.heading: Equipment Used for Site Preparation
equipment.subheading: Heavy equipment and transport resources for efficient site clearing, grading, and earthmoving.

items.title: Dozer
items.description: Used for bulk earthmoving, stripping topsoil, rough grading, and shaping building pads.

items.title: Excavator
items.description: Handles excavation, trenching, material placement, and detailed site shaping.

items.title: Skid Steer
items.description: Used for fine grading, cleanup, material handling, and preparing surfaces for construction.

items.title: Off-Road Dump Truck
items.description: Moves material efficiently around the site without relying on public road access.

items.title: Tri-Axle Dump Truck
items.description: Hauls excavated material off-site and delivers fill, granular base, and aggregates as needed.

items.title: Laser & GPS Grade Control
items.description: Ensures accurate elevations, slopes, and consistent grading across the site.

process.heading: Our Site Preparation Process
process.subheading: Organized, efficient, and built around your project schedule.

steps.title: Site Walk & Planning
steps.description: We review drawings, grades, and drainage needs.

steps.title: Topsoil Removal
steps.description: Stripping and stockpiling or hauling of topsoil as required.

steps.title: Rough Grading
steps.description: We shape the land to match proposed elevations.

steps.title: Pad & Access Prep
steps.description: We create stable access roads and building pads.

steps.title: Final Grading
steps.description: Final shaping for drainage and site usability.

serviceArea.heading: Service Area
serviceArea.content: Site preparation and grading services available throughout Brant County and surrounding regions.

items.question: Can you prepare sites for new builds?
items.answer: Yes, we regularly prepare sites for new homes, shops, and agricultural buildings.

items.question: Do you handle drainage issues?
items.answer: Yes, grading and ditching for drainage is a core part of site prep.

items.question: Can you work from engineered site plans?
items.answer: Yes, we work directly from survey and engineering drawings.
